name: A10-0103/2026 – Andrey Kovatchev – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what the European Union should push for at the United Nations General Assembly in September 2026. It asks the Council and the Commission to defend a rules-based world order with the United Nations at its centre, to back reform of the United Nations, and to take clear positions on Ukraine, the Middle East, Georgia, Cyprus, Taiwan, Africa and human rights. This is a recommendation, not a law: it does not change any rules itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament gives political advice to the Council and Commission.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, EU foreign policy officials, and EU partners at the United Nations.
- **What happens next:** The recommendation goes to the Council, the Commission and the EU foreign policy chief, and to the United Nations for information.
